artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image features two primary figures and several celestial beings. One person sits on the right, leaning towards a book on a desk or altar while looking upwards. The person wears long robes. A group of angelic beings surrounds them, with wings and dramatic gestures. One angel extends an arm holding a staff towards the central figure. Above them, a radiant light emanates from a central circular motif with a dove. The background includes clouds and beams of light, creating a heavenly atmosphere. A detailed pedestal and ornamental column are visible on the lower left. The scene depicts the interaction between an earthly presence and celestial entities.

artworks.title: Massacre of the Innocents [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on blue-green paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring figures and architecture. The artwork depicts a crowded scene with numerous figures interacting amidst an architectural setting dominated by large columns. The drawing uses heavy shading and detailed linework to give the impression of depth and complexity, with figures in various poses suggestive of movement. The background features architectural elements like columns and arches which emphasize the grandeur of the scene. The drawing style has a classical and Renaissance influence, focusing on the human form and architectural detail.

artworks.title: View of Mons, Belgium
artworks.medium: pen in brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a slightly elevated perspective. It overlooks a flat expanse stretching towards a distant town. The horizon is placed in the middle of the composition, with a collection of buildings including a church with spires and a windmill. The brushwork is subtle and precise, using fine lines and light washes in shades of sepia and muted grays. The terrain close to us has textures and undulations, leading the eye into the scene. A building's corner is visible on the right edge. In the distance, the town is delicately sketched with quaint architecture and foliage along the horizon line. The color palette is soft and monochromatic, featuring warm browns and cool grays for a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Tea
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting with her body turned to the right. Her right arm rests on a surface outside of the frame. She has a calm expression and is looking slightly to the side. Her dark hair is pulled back, revealing her facial features. She wears a light-colored garment with draped straps. She holds a partially open folding fan in her right hand. There is a small table with a cup, saucer, and pitcher next to her. The background is a textured dark surface with some floral or patterned elements.

artworks.title: Mon Enfant (My Child)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid Chinese paper
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up profile of a child's face, featuring soft, rounded facial features typical of a young child. The child's head is slightly tilted downward with closed eyes and fine, short hair. They are wearing a simple garment with a rounded neckline, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Isola del Lazaretto Nuovo
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing shows a river scene with a building on the opposite bank. Boats and gondolas are on the water in front of us with some people onboard, and in the distance, buildings and trees fade into the horizon. The color palette is subdued, consisting of earthy browns and cool greys.

artworks.title: The Infant Christ and Saint John Playing with the Lamb
artworks.artist: Christoffel Jegher after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two young children interacting with a large, furry dog in a natural environment. The children have round faces, plump cheeks, and curly hair. They are standing, with one child extending their arm towards the dog, and the other leaning slightly forward. The children are dressed in simple attire with cloth draped over their bodies. The setting includes a detailed tree on the left, surrounded by smaller plants and rocks. In the background, there is a pastoral landscape with trees, shrubs, a softly rolling terrain, and a partly cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Old Woman
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a chair. The person is centered, with their hands resting on their lap and legs slightly apart. Their face appears indistinct due to the dark and textured nature of the image, with prominent cheekbones and a neutral expression. The person wears a dark robe with a hood, concealing much of their hair. The garment blends into the shadowy surroundings. The background features an unclear, textured landscape, potentially depicting a natural scene with trees and an open sky. The image has deep shadows and a monochromatic palette, creating a somber mood.

artworks.title: Two Nude Men
artworks.medium: engraving

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt (La fuite en Egypte)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with lush foliage, meandering paths, a line of trees on the horizon, and figures walking along a path. Detailed trees with textured leaves dominate the right side of the composition. The sky is depicted with delicate, horizontal lines. The color palette is monochrome, mainly using sepia tones to create light and shadow effects.

artworks.title: Seated Bishop
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and chalk with brown wash heightened with white
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile of a person seated and reading a book. The person is depicted wearing voluminous robes and a tall, pointed hat, sometimes associated with ecclesiastical attire. The person's facial features are delicate with a slightly prominent nose, and their expression is focused on the book. The person's body is covered by the intricate robe, and they hold an object, likely the book. The background is minimal, with a soft wash of color. The sketch is done in warm tones.

artworks.title: View of Fondi
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape drawing with a high horizon, featuring distant mountains and a walled city with towers and buildings. Brushwork creates texture and depth, with trees framing the scene. The monochrome color palette uses sepia tones to create a warm and aged look. This drawing effectively conveys distance and scale through line work.

artworks.title: Aeneas Carrying Anchises from Burning Troy
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on tan laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures posing against billowing smoke and architectural structures. The drawing is done in ink and a wash technique on textured paper, using fluid lines to define forms and movement. The figures are muscular, with shadows accentuating their physique. The background includes swirling clouds and city-like structures. Shading adds depth and emphasizes dramatic tension in the scene.

artworks.title: Classical Landscape with a Fountain
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash over black chalk
artworks.description: The image is a landscape drawing from an elevated perspective. The scene depicts hills, a building on a hill with trees around it, two figures, a dog, and oxen near a circular trough. Fine brushstrokes detail the foliage and texture of the landscape. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and sepia. A large tree on the left frames the image, leading the eye towards the hills and the sky.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper, laid down on blue paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting multiple figures in various dynamic poses. The composition shows figures in motion, with some crouching, reaching or lifting, and one figure lying on a central platform. The scene conveys a sense of high activity or turmoil, with the figures positioned dynamically throughout. The use of lines and shading creates depth and a three-dimensional effect, enhancing the drama. The drawing uses a monochrome palette to emphasize form and action.

artworks.title: Lucretia
artworks.medium: watercolor heightened with white over black chalk
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 29.8 x 20.9 cm (11 3/4 x 8 1/4 in.)
overall: 86.3 cm (34 in.)

artworks.title: A Sacred Sheet Sent from Holy Mother Wisdom by Her Angel of Many Signs
artworks.medium: pen and blue ink
artworks.dimensions:
sight size: 43.2 x 34 cm (17 x 13 3/8 in.)
framed: 53.3 x 44.1 cm (21 x 17 3/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This drawing features an array of geometric shapes and intricate line patterns arranged in an abstract manner. At the center, there's a rectangular formation with a circular pattern inside. On either side of the central shape, there are additional circular designs divided into segments, with one on the right that looks like a sun. At the top and bottom of the drawing are several vertical and horizontal lines that connect to other circular and angular forms. These forms themselves are made up of small swirling lines that look almost like cursive letters of varying sizes. The lines and shapes are drawn in dark blue on off-white paper that appears slightly wrinkled.

artworks.title: Poor House, Hospital & Lunatick-Hospital of Northampton County, Pa.
artworks.medium: watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a bird's-eye view of a compound labeled as the "Poor House, Hospital & Lunatick-Hospital of Northampton County, Pa." The perspective shows rolling hills, mountains, and a pale blue sky with clouds. Central are well-structured brick buildings with blue roofs and smoke rising from chimneys. In the foreground, there are cattle, a horse, and trees in a fenced area. The painting features detailed architecture and a vivid rural environment with a rich color palette.

artworks.title: Mother's Banner of Love and Comfort
artworks.medium: pen and blue and red ink on paper mounted on cotton fabric
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image contains various geometric shapes such as triangles, diamonds, and ovals, with a central rectangular grid. The arrangement of these shapes and the text within and around them forms an abstract composition. The triangular shapes resemble peaks, while the grid in the center is reminiscent of a scoreboard or graph paper. The ovals at the bottom contain densely packed text. Small ornate tree-like forms are dispersed throughout the image.

artworks.title: The Cotters Saturday Night
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people sitting indoors at a wooden table in an L-shape. They vary in age and appearance. On the left, a woman in a bonnet and shawl sits next to a man in a blue jacket. Next to them, a woman in a yellow and white dress holds a book. A young boy with a red jacket and two young girls focus on an older man at the head of the table. The older man reads from a large book in front of a lit candle. The room has wooden beams, shelves with crockery, birds on rafters, and a cat on the floor.

artworks.title: A Fruit-Bearing Tree; A Cedar of Paradise
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with colored wash over graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a large central tree with dark green leaves and various red and purple fruits or flowers. The color palette includes dark greens, soft pinks, deep reds, and golds on a light cream background. There are large, colorful blooms in shades of red, pink, and yellow below the tree. Two golden fountains are at the base of the tree, and a decorative gold structure is to the right. A detailed script and small decorative elements in red and yellow cover the lower portion of the image.

artworks.title: Harpsichord Recital at Count Rumford's, Concord, New Hampshire
artworks.medium: transparent and opaque watercolor, pen and black ink, and graphite on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sight size: 18.7 x 26.3 cm (7 3/8 x 10 3/8 in.)
framed: 24.4 x 32 cm (9 5/8 x 12 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior scene. The room features elegantly dressed individuals around a harpsichord or piano, engaging with music sheets. The room is richly adorned with a brightly patterned carpet, pale green walls, oval and rectangular framed art pieces, decorative trim on the ceiling, and a fireplace on the left side. Portraits and small paintings adorn the fireplace.

artworks.title: To the Memory of George H. and Ruel T. Hills
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor, partly stenciled
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The painting captures a rural scene from an elevated perspective. The horizon is positioned towards the upper third of the image, showcasing rolling hills with trees extending into the distance. A tall tree with thick trunk and green leaves is at the center. There is a small lake with swans and a sailboat. Simple houses of warm colors are scattered across the landscape. The brushstrokes emphasize form and texture. The color palette includes earthy greens, browns, and soft pastel blue. The painting is framed with a decorative border.

artworks.title: The Ludlow Patton
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The painting depicts a river landscape with an elevated point of view, showing a bridge and city in the distance. The horizon is high in the composition, with a hazy skyline and a prominent dome visible. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, outlining trees, buildings, and boats. The color palette is soft with blues and greens, creating a serene ambiance. There are boats, figures, and a horse-drawn carriage near the river, leading to a bustling bridge. In the distance, a cityscape unfolds with various buildings. The sky is lightly clouded.
